Name: Basic Attack
Description: Neuro takes out a stick and waves it shooting out a light blue blast that hits an enemy

Name: Anvil Smash
Description: Neuro checks her pockets to find nothing, shrugs, then a giant anvil falls and crushes an opposing enemy.

Name: Protective Bubble
Description: Neuro blows bubbles and generates a shield around herself or another party member

Name: Healing Touch
Description: Neuro takes a stick out of her pocket and whirls it to heal herself or another party member

Name: Drone Strike
Description: Summon a drone that attacks an enemy

Name: Magic blast
Description: Neuro takes out a staff and whirls it to shoot a big magic sphere out at an enemy

Name: Colourful Array
Description: Neuro uses a wooden staff to cast a veil above your party that gradually heals team members for 3 turns.

Name: Basic Attack
Description: Evil throws a harpoon at an enemy

Name: Blow up the crowd
Description: Evil lets out a roar and causes an explosion that damages both you and the enemy

Name: Pipe Attack
Description: Strike an enemy with a metal pipe dealing damage to that enemy and lowering other enemies’ defense

Name: Fire it up
Description: Evil takes out a mic and screams into it causing sparklers to fire and buffing your team’s attack and lowering defence of both sides of the field

Name: Flare
Description: Evil does a fiery spin and applies burn to all enemies

Name: Fireball
Description: Evil charges up with her fists and shoots a fireball at an enemy applying burn

Name: BOOM
Description: Evil goes full beast mode and enters a state for 3 turns in which your speed and attack stats are buffed but you take damage every time you deal damage.
